mr: Add account deletion so users can remove their account and all associated data, and make the session check tolerate expired tokens instead of throwing.

purposes.title: removeUserContent deletes each of the user's posts with where: { id: userId } instead of the post's own id, so it deletes the post whose id equals the user id (another user's post) and leaves the user's own posts in place
removeUserContent loads the user's posts, comments, and likes with findMany and then deletes them one by one in a loop, issuing one delete round-trip per row instead of a single deleteMany

deleteAccount runs removeUserContent and removeUser as separate awaited calls with no transaction, so a failure between them leaves the account partially deleted with orphaned content or a half-removed user
The session check replaces jwt.verify with jwt.decode to stop throwing on expired tokens, dropping signature verification so a forged or unsigned token is accepted and any user id can be impersonated
